spec.title: moblord compute
spec.description: Agent and compute telemetry for tuning the setup: the CI run ledger, the host snapshots and the test history (job moblord-ci in Loki; ops/telemetry/README.md), node_exporter and T3 Code's own metrics. One row per question; `pnpm compute:report` is the same data as a weekly text report with suggestions.

spec.title: CI wall time by tier and host kind
spec.description: Hours of ci:check and check:fast wall time per interval, from the run ledger (scripts/run-ledger.mjs). Host kind is local, boat-warm (a reused VM) or boat-fresh (a new VM). Back-filled runs carry no wall time.

spec.expr: sum by (kind, tier, host_kind) (sum_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=~`ci:check|check:fast` | json v="wallS" | unwrap v [$__auto])) / 3600

spec.title: Runs and outcome by tier and host
spec.description: Run count over the selected range by kind, tier, host kind and exit code (0 passed; back-filled runs have no exit code).

spec.expr: sum by (kind, tier, host_kind, host, exit) (count_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=~`ci:check|check:fast` [$__range]))

spec.title: CI wall time by agent thread
spec.description: Minutes of ci:check and check:fast wall time per agent thread over the selected range, with its model, ticket and checkout. Thread IDs are T3CODE_THREAD_ID.

spec.expr: topk(20, sum by (thread, model, ticket, worktree) (sum_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=~`ci:check|check:fast` | thread!=`` | json v="wallS" | unwrap v [$__range]))) / 60

spec.title: CI slot wait (local runs)
spec.description: Seconds a local ci:check waited for a machine-wide CI slot (scripts/ci-gate.mjs): the longest and the average per interval, by host.

spec.expr: max by (host) (max_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=`ci:check` | host_kind=`local` | json v="slotWaitS" | unwrap v [$__auto]))
avg by (host) (avg_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=`ci:check` | host_kind=`local` | json v="slotWaitS" | unwrap v [$__auto]))

spec.title: Stage time per run
spec.description: Average seconds per stage of a ci:check run: static checks, unit tests, integration tests.

spec.expr: avg by (tier) (avg_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=`ci:check` | json v="stages.staticS" | unwrap v [$__auto]))
avg by (tier) (avg_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=`ci:check` | json v="stages.unitS" | unwrap v [$__auto]))
avg by (tier) (avg_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=`ci:check` | json v="stages.integrationS" | unwrap v [$__auto]))

spec.title: Load per core and CPU pressure
spec.description: node_exporter: 1-minute load divided by cores (1.0 = saturated) and the share of time tasks waited for a CPU. nino-pc is nino-pc; ninodev is dev-box-vm.

spec.expr: node_load1{instance=~"nino-pc|dev-box-vm"} / on (instance) count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", instance=~"nino-pc|dev-box-vm"})
rate(node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total{instance=~"nino-pc|dev-box-vm"}[$__rate_interval])

spec.title: Hottest sensor
spec.description: node_hwmon_temp_celsius, the maximum over every sensor of the host. nino-pc reached 92 °C under load on 2026-11-10.

spec.expr: max by (instance) (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{instance=~"nino-pc|dev-box-vm"})

spec.title: CPU by command (cores)
spec.description: Cores used per kind of process group, from the minute snapshots (ops/telemetry/host-snapshot.py): ci:check, check:fast, a vitest run outside both, browsers, the game server, blender, the agents themselves, other tools agents started, and everything else. Both hosts added up; see the next panel for who.

spec.expr: sum(avg_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="cpu.ci" | unwrap v [$__auto])) / 100
sum(avg_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="cpu.checkFast" | unwrap v [$__auto])) / 100
sum(avg_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="cpu.vitest" | unwrap v [$__auto])) / 100
sum(avg_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="cpu.browser" | unwrap v [$__auto])) / 100
sum(avg_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="cpu.game" | unwrap v [$__auto])) / 100
sum(avg_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="cpu.blender" | unwrap v [$__auto])) / 100
sum(avg_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="cpu.agent" | unwrap v [$__auto])) / 100
sum(avg_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="cpu.agentTools" | unwrap v [$__auto])) / 100
sum(avg_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="cpu.other" | unwrap v [$__auto])) / 100

spec.title: Top CPU owner while SATURATED
spec.description: Minutes in the selected range in which this command, checkout and agent thread was the busiest process group on a host whose verdict was SATURATED (load at least its core count, or CPU pressure 20 % or more).

spec.expr: sum by (host, top_kind, top_worktree, top_thread) (count_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | verdict=`SATURATED` | json top_kind="top.kind", top_worktree="top.worktree", top_thread="top.thread" [$__range]))

spec.title: CI slots, queue and stray vitest
spec.description: Per host: CI slots held, ci:check runs waiting for a slot, vitest runs outside the CI queue, and agent processes.

spec.expr: max by (host) (max_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="slotsHeld" | unwrap v [$__auto]))
max by (host) (max_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="queued" | unwrap v [$__auto]))
max by (host) (max_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="vitestBare" | unwrap v [$__auto]))
max by (host) (max_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="agents" | unwrap v [$__auto]))

spec.title: Saturated minutes
spec.description: The snapshots whose verdict was SATURATED, newest first: host, load, the busiest command and its owner.

spec.expr: {job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | verdict=`SATURATED` | json load1="load1", tempC="tempC", top_kind="top.kind", top_cpu="top.cpuPct", top_worktree="top.worktree", top_thread="top.thread" | line_format "{{.host}} load {{.load1}} {{.tempC}}°C  top: {{.top_kind}} {{.top_cpu}}% of a core  {{.top_worktree}}  {{.top_thread}}"

spec.title: Starts left (day, hour)
spec.description: From `boat limits`, sampled every five minutes by the host snapshot. Agents stop routing to boat below 15 starts left today or 5 this hour.

spec.expr: min(min_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="boat.startsLeftDay" | unwrap v [$__auto]))
min(min_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="boat.startsLeftHour" | unwrap v [$__auto]))

spec.title: VMs up, idle and VM-hours left
spec.description: From `boat list` and `boat limits`: VMs up, VMs idle (a warm VM waiting for its next run), and the plan's VM-hours left this month (555 a month).

spec.expr: max(max_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="boat.vmsUp" | unwrap v [$__auto]))
max(max_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="boat.vmsIdle" | unwrap v [$__auto]))
min(min_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="load"} | json v="boat.vmHoursLeft" | unwrap v [$__auto]))

spec.title: Warm reuse rate
spec.description: Share of boat-ci runs in the selected range that reused a warm VM (no start spent).

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=`boat-ci` | host_kind=`boat-warm` [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=`boat-ci` [$__range]))

spec.title: boat-ci runs by tier, VM type and reuse
spec.description: boat-ci runs over the selected range: tier, warm (reused) or fresh, and exit code.

spec.expr: sum by (tier, host_kind, host, exit) (count_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=`boat-ci` [$__range]))

spec.title: Starts used and VM-seconds by boat-ci
spec.description: Per interval, from the ledger's boat-ci lines: VM starts spent and VM wall seconds (a large VM bills 2×).

spec.expr: sum(sum_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=`boat-ci` | json v="startsUsed" | unwrap v [$__auto]))
sum(sum_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=`boat-ci` | json v="vmSeconds" | unwrap v [$__auto])) / 60

spec.title: Cost per run and in total
spec.description: Dollars from the ledger's boat-ci lines: the average per run and the sum over the selected range. Idle time of warm VMs is not in a run's cost.

spec.expr: avg(avg_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=`boat-ci` | json v="costUsd" | unwrap v [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=`boat-ci` | json v="costUsd" | unwrap v [$__range]))

spec.title: Local ci:check on ninodev (fallbacks)
spec.description: Every ci:check tier on ninodev is meant to run on boat (ZDX-710). A local one there is a fallback: boat under its thresholds, or the rule ignored. Compare with the starts-left panel.

spec.expr: sum by (tier) (count_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs", host="ninodev"} | kind=`ci:check` | host_kind=`local` [$__auto]))

spec.title: Failures: timeout or assertion
spec.description: Test files that did not pass, per interval. A timeout (every failed test of the file timed out) is a load flake until shown otherwise; a fail caught something.

spec.expr: sum by (result) (count_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="tests"} | result=~`fail|timeout` [$__auto]))

spec.title: Flaky and failing files
spec.description: Files that failed or timed out in the selected range, by result. The same file under both results is the interesting kind of flaky.

spec.expr: topk(30, sum by (file, result) (count_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="tests"} | result=~`fail|timeout` [$__range])))

spec.title: Slowest files (mean seconds)
spec.description: Mean duration of the slowest passing files over the selected range. Only files of 3 s or more are shipped (ops/telemetry/ship.py).

spec.expr: topk(25, avg by (file) (avg_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="tests"} | result=`pass` | json v="ms" | unwrap v [$__range]))) / 1000

spec.title: Slow files over time
spec.description: The ten slowest passing files per interval: a line that climbs is a file getting slower.

spec.expr: topk(10, avg by (file) (avg_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="tests"} | result=`pass` | json v="ms" | unwrap v [$__auto]))) / 1000

spec.title: Cold files skipped per thorough run
spec.description: plan.coldSkipped of ci:check --thorough runs: the size of the cold set as the runs saw it. A step is cold-set churn; `pnpm compute:report` names the files.

spec.expr: max by (host) (max_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=`ci:check` | tier=`thorough` | json v="plan.coldSkipped" | unwrap v [$__auto]))

spec.title: Gate runs per thread
spec.description: ci:check runs per agent thread over the selected range, with model and exit code. Several failed runs before a pass is a fix-and-rerun loop; `pnpm compute:report` counts them and their gaps.

spec.expr: sum by (thread, model, ticket, exit) (count_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=`ci:check` | thread!=`` [$__range]))

spec.title: Gate pass rate by model
spec.description: Share of ci:check runs with an agent thread that passed, by the model that ran them (from the session's transcript, the model field only).

spec.expr: sum by (model) (count_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=`ci:check` | thread!=`` | exit=`0` [$__range])) / sum by (model) (count_over_time({job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | kind=`ci:check` | thread!=`` [$__range]))

spec.title: T3 runs by model family and outcome
spec.description: T3 Code's own metric t3_runs_total (finished agent runs), by host, model family, outcome and whether the run was delegated. host_name comes from target_info: the instance label changes with every T3 restart.

spec.expr: sum by (host_name, modelFamily, outcome, delegated) (increase(t3_runs_total[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (host_name) target_info{job="t3code/t3code-server"})

spec.title: T3 run duration (p50, p95)
spec.description: t3_run_duration_milliseconds by model family: how long an agent run takes.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, modelFamily) (rate(t3_run_duration_milliseconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]))) / 1000
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, modelFamily) (rate(t3_run_duration_milliseconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]))) / 1000

spec.title: T3 run queue wait (p95) and process groups
spec.description: t3_run_queue_wait_milliseconds p95 by host, and the CPU percent of T3's process groups (server, claude, terminal, other).

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, host_name) (rate(t3_run_queue_wait_milliseconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (host_name) target_info{job="t3code/t3code-server"})) / 1000
sum by (host_name, group) (t3_process_group_cpu_percent * on (instance) group_left (host_name) target_info{job="t3code/t3code-server"})

spec.title: Run ledger
spec.description: The ledger lines themselves, newest first. Expand one for every field (plan, stages, failing files).

spec.expr: {job="moblord-ci", stream="runs"} | json wallS="wallS", failedStep="failedStep" | line_format "{{.host}} {{.kind}} {{.tier}} {{.host_kind}} exit={{.exit}} {{.wallS}}s {{.failedStep}}  {{.model}} {{.ticket}} {{.worktree}}  {{.thread}}"
